provisionalNotice: PROVISIONAL (pre-freeze). Not an offer, qualification or gate result; nothing here enables a cell, selects an allowance or changes a default.
note: The profile is wall-clock time of one instrumented native request: an attribution run, not a timing run. Finder and apply times include the cost of their own timers (estimated in overhead.json).

definitions.partition: every booked millisecond is in exactly one of: finderCovered (S3-implemented finders), finderRemaining (the other registered finders), apply (applying Findings), solveSetup (state, ladder, givens, report outside the loop), solveLoop (the ladder loop outside finders and applications: ladder walk, checks, bookkeeping), dfs (the four DFS entry points), rateSelf (difficulty.rate outside its solve: classification), gridGenerate (fullGrid.generate outside its DFS), stageSelf (the code of the pipeline steps and of the stages themselves, and the gaps of the restart loop: the explicit residual of unnamed work)

reportAnchors.other: G13 ~72 % / ~28 % belongs to another cohort of the report; no anchor for the other headline cells

reconciliation.note: booked = every stage cell and finder cell; the residual is floating-point error only. The host ready wall also holds the worker's toWire, the snapshot and the message delivery after the run.

sampleVsLocal.note: sample = ordinary + proposal samples; local = the local-continuation sample of an attempt (its dig, rating and tune steps included); other = setup and the full grids, extra structure and restart loop. Request-group time of a cohort is not this.

checkTotals.exactness: INEXACT: the loop-check part is derived from the finder passes (one per pass plus one before a stuck result), a count that misses a check that throws before the first finder or before returning stuck and every pass of an empty ladder; the finder-check part counts ctx.check() calls only and misses the budget checks that nishio and forcingChain issue through SG.constraints.place/propagate on variants with propagation extensions (tech-chain.js, constraints.js: read from the source, not measured); the r1 profile was not rerun

counters.note: canonical ratings = difficulty.rate calls (equal to the engine's own work ratings); oracle solves = logical solves that are not inside a rating; DFS entries/checks/backtracks are separate counters; DFS checks are the checks of the search loop only (checks inside constraint propagation are not counted)

revision.name: r2
revision.note: Revision r2 (the pack author's review of r1): the S3 figures are relabelled conditional zero-cost scenarios (r1 called some of them ceilings of a full S3); the bias-adjusted column is dropped; the r1 budget-check totals are marked inexact (loop-check boundaries; the propagation checks of nishio and forcingChain that ctx.check does not see); the loop-check comparison ran on the real engine (shard lc); the fingerprints of the run, the r1 report, the fixed harness and this report are kept apart; the $env:TEMP slip is disclosed. The r1 documents and every record are kept, and the nine profile commands were not rerun.
